CSV Column Splitter

Split names, addresses, or delimited data in CSV spreadsheets without Excel. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Splits combined spreadsheet columns (such as 'First Last' names, 'City, State, Zip' addresses, or compound product SKUs) into distinct separate columns based on spaces, commas, or custom delimiters without needing Microsoft Excel or complex spreadsheet formulas.

How to use

  1. Upload any standard CSV spreadsheet file from your local computer.
  2. Choose the specific column index containing the combined text you need to divide.
  3. Specify the delimiter character to split on (defaults to a single space character).
  4. Click the Split Column button and download your restructured, multi-column CSV file.

Limits & Considerations

Handles RFC 4180 compliant CSV files with quoted strings. Extremely large datasets (>50MB) may take several seconds to parse in browser memory.

Privacy & Security

Spreadsheet records are parsed client-side with pure JavaScript. No sensitive financial records or corporate spreadsheets are transmitted online.
